links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with AI-aided versus conventional colonoscopy
links.effect: ADR 42% overall; 41% AI-C vs 43% CC, no significant difference. PDR trend higher with AI; SSL detection 22% vs 11% (p=0.004). No difference in polyps or adenomas per colonoscopy.
links.quote: The ADR was 42% for all patients, and no significant difference emerged between AI-C and CC groups (41% vs 43%).

screen.reason: Prospective randomized controlled trial testing real-world deployment/use of commercial computer-aided detection systems (GI Genius and CADEye) during live colonoscopies, comparing AI-assisted vs conventional colonoscopy.
